result.effect: 1,455 unique axiom identifiers; 1,464 work-axiom mappings; 149 unique works; seven axioms mapped to more than one work, with a maximum of four mappings

cells.quote: "Only seven axioms map to more than one work, with a maximum of four mappings, so the present artifact is better characterized as a set of work-derived records than as a densely reused cross-work ontology."
cells.note: No study text is available; quote copied from the wiki entry. The entry reports a descriptive audit, but does not state a treatment effect, study design, learner characteristics, setting, or duration.

O.outcome_detail: students having to redo the exercise

cells.quote: From these students, 22 had to redo their homework exercise on axiomatic proofs. This is significantly higher than, for example, the number of students in the same group who had to redo the exercise on semantic tableaux: 5 out of 65.
cells.note: Observational comparison of homework exercise types; no random assignment or printed effect size.
